title: Best AI Coding Tools in 2026: Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, and Codex — Ranked
summary: Compare the 6 best AI coding tools in 2026: Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Codex CLI, and Aider. Honest review of pricing, strengths, and use cases.
body_markdown: Claude Code has the strongest large-codebase handling — its file-traversal approach and extended context window maintain coherence across hundreds of files. Cursor uses codebase indexing with a rolling context window, which works well for most real-world projects. Aider is solid but works best with targeted file selection on large repos. GitHub Copilot and Windsurf are strongest on file-level work rather than deep cross-repo reasoning.
